dict.string: AntiSleep AI uses the microphone for hands-free voice commands, wake word activation ('Антислип'), and interactive verbal co-pilot games to keep the driver awake.
AntiSleep AI connects to vehicle audio systems via Bluetooth to automatically route hands-free voice alerts and driver safety warnings through car speakers.

AntiSleep AI uses the front-facing camera to monitor eye openness and detect driver drowsiness in real time.

AntiSleep AI keeps tracking your route and monitoring driver safety in background and Picture-in-Picture modes.
